info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Banking Accounts Statements-v1-spec
info.description: The Banking Account Statements API enables clients to retrieve detailed statements for their banking accounts. This endpoint allows users to access transaction history, including deposits and withdrawals, over specified periods. Typical consumers include bank account holders looking to review their financial activity for budgeting and accounting purposes. By providing easy access to account statements, this API supports financial transparency and informed decision-making.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the statements associated with your accounts. You can use this to get detailed insights into your transactions over a specified period.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve account statements. It should contain the necessary parameters to specify the details of the statements required. Please ensure that the request complies with the schema provided.
